audience: recruiting teams that post jobs and manage candidates in Teamtailor

useCases.title: List jobs and their hiring stages
useCases.text: List jobs by status, then read the hiring stages of a job to see its pipeline.

useCases.title: Find recent candidates and applications
useCases.text: List candidates by creation date, or job applications by the date their stage changed.

useCases.title: Read one candidate and their application
useCases.text: Open one candidate and one job application to read the contact details, the job and the current stage.

useCases.title: Add a candidate and apply them to a job
useCases.text: Create a candidate, then add them to a job as a new application. No email goes to the candidate unless you turn on user notifications.

useCases.title: Add an internal note to an application
useCases.text: Add an internal note to a candidate, written as one team user and linked to one job application.

useCases.title: Update a candidate's contact details
useCases.text: Change the name, email, phone or pitch of one candidate. Other fields and applications are not touched.
